cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

types/CollateralDatum.title: CollateralDatum
types/CollateralDatum.description:
The datum structure for `UTXO`s in the collateral manager contract. If the field `used_in` is
 populated, the collateral is considered locked and cannot be withdrawn by its owner.
 The `borrow_commitment` field stores the ZK commitment for anonymous borrowing.

types/CollateralValidatorParams.title: CollateralValidatorParams
types/CollateralValidatorParams.description: The parameter for when compiling the parameterized collateral management contract

types/DepositContractParams.title: DepositContractParams
types/DepositContractParams.description: Parameter for the V3 Deposit Contract

types/DepositDatum.title: DepositDatum
types/DepositDatum.description:
The datum structure for deposit UTXOs in the V3 deposit contract
 Contains collateral information and Poseidon commitment for ZK proofs

types/DepositRedeemer.title: DepositRedeemer
types/DepositRedeemer.description: Redeemer for the V3 Deposit Contract

types/LendingPoolDatum.title: LendingPoolDatum
types/LendingPoolDatum.description:
The lending pool `UTXO` datum structure.

 - `collateral_contract`: the `ScriptHash` of the collateral validator
 - `loanable_asset`: the `AssetClass` of the stable coin or any asset that can be borrowed
 - `collateral_asset`: the `AssetClass` of the asset that can be used as collateral
 - `collateral_price`: the exchange rate of the collateral asset against the loanable asset
 - `collateral_ratio`: the loan-to-value ratio of the collateral asset, expressed in whole number percentage figure (eg: `70` for 70%)
 - `interest_rates`: the list of [`InterestRate`](#InterestRate) tuples

types/LendingPoolValidatorParams.title: LendingPoolValidatorParams
types/LendingPoolValidatorParams.description: The parameter for when compiling the parameterized lending pool contract

types/LoanDatum.title: LoanDatum
types/LoanDatum.description:
The loan info data structure that is present in [`CollateralDatum`](#CollateralDatum)
 if the UTXO is used as collateral in an active loan.

types/UnifiedRedeemer.title: UnifiedRedeemer
types/UnifiedRedeemer.description:
The data structure for the redeemer that can be used for both the collateral management contract
 and the lending pool contract.

types/V3LendingPoolDatum.title: V3LendingPoolDatum
types/V3LendingPoolDatum.description:
V3 Lending Pool Datum (simplified for privacy)
 Tracks total deposits and available liquidity
